reference.title: Scenario 3 — No Heading 1 present
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document where the author starts the content with Heading 2 and never applies

section.p: Consider a document where the author starts the content with Heading 2 and never applies Heading 1 anywhere in the document. Similarly, in another case, the author may skip both Heading 1 and Heading 2 and start directly with Heading 3.

section.p: Result: The converter promotes Heading 2 to Heading 1 or Heading 3 to Heading 1 during conversion. The conversion succeeds and all Heading 2 or Heading 3 are converted to separate DITAMAPs.
section.note: For the most predictable and semantically correct DITA output, always begin each document with Heading 1 and follow a sequential heading hierarchy (Heading 1 → Heading 2 → Heading 3) without skipping levels.
